snippet.title: They See Us Trailer 2
snippet.description:
They See Us is a multiplayer horror game for 1-4 players coming to Steam this year. Your team must count how many anomalous entities are inhabiting an office space and correctly input the answer before the time runs out. Progress through the stages to ascend - or die trying.

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551100/They_See_Us/

Join us on Discord!
https://discord.gg/K4g9XtZPuy
